But fragments list only carbon fragments; maybe they omitted O because they only list carbon fragments. So we can have OCH3 attached to aromatic.

Thus total carbons: aromatic 6 + carbonyl carbon 1 + two methyls 2 =9. Still missing one carbon. CH3 groups count: we have three CH3 groups (methoxy + two N-methyls) but answer says 2 CH3 groups. Hmm discrepancy. The given answer for CH3 groups is 2. So only two methyl groups present. Good. So total CH3 groups =2. Aromatic ring has two substituents: carbonyl amide and methoxy. N-methyl attached to N. So structure: p-methoxy-N-methylbenzamide?
